meta.coordinates: nodes = [x, y, walk_id]; x,y in metres, the merged-map estimated camera centre C=-R^T t chained: step 1 is mapped by one fixed rigid transform T0 (Kabsch, no scale, fitted once at the last 55-submap step on the component that holds node 0, only to make the picture north-up); every later step is mapped by ONE rigid transform (Kabsch, no scale) fitted from its estimate to the previous step's display over the nodes that are in the main component at both steps, so no ground truth is used after T0 and the optimiser's non-rigid changes stay visible. Main component = the one holding node 0. Nodes outside it (steps[].unlinked = half-open node-index ranges) have no known place in the map: T0 rotation only, drawn in a tray just outside the lower-left corner of the final map's bounding box (30 m gap, 20 m between components). the plane is GT axes x,y (GT position variance per axis [65461.2, 16921.7, 12.4]). links = [node_a, node_b] indices into nodes of the same step, cross-walk covis edges only
meta.fixed_frame_rmse_m: steps[].fixed_frame_rmse_m = RMSE to GT of the largest component under the fixed transform (consistency check of the frame across steps; not used for drawing)
meta.walk_assignment: node belongs to the submap whose merge step appended it; cross-checked with raw timestamps
meta.ate_definition: ate_rmse_m = RMSE of position after aligning each connected component of the step (odom+covis graph) to GT with its own rigid transform (Umeyama, no scale), pooled over nodes; ate_rmse_single_align_m = one rigid alignment for all nodes, as literally requested; they differ when the map is split into components that live in different frames
meta.note: submaps 55 and 56 have no raw data, no GT (identity) and fake timestamps; ATE excludes their nodes
